cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WITH count(d) AS totalDocs MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d2:Document) WITH totalDocs, d2, sum(c.char_count) AS totalChars, count(c) AS chunkCount ORDER BY totalChars DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN totalDocs, d2.doc_id AS topDoc, d2.title AS topTitle, chunkCount, totalChars
note: Count all Document nodes, then aggregate char_count per document via PART_OF chunks to find the largest by total content.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk) RETURN c.provenance AS provenance, count(c) AS chunkCount, sum(c.char_count) AS totalChars ORDER BY totalChars DESC
note: Group all chunks by their provenance property (e.g. SYNTHESIZED vs vendor-grounded) and sum char_count to show corpus proportion.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE c.text CONTAINS '%%LIBMEMSYM' OR c.heading CONTAINS '%%LIBMEMSYM' OR c.text CONTAINS 'LIBMEMSYM' RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 20
note: Literal substring search for the LIBMEMSYM token across chunk text and headings, since it looks like a Control-M %% variable.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'ctmcreate' OR toLower(c.heading) CONTAINS 'ctmcreate' RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 20
note: Case-insensitive search for the ctmcreate utility name in chunk text/headings.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE c.text CONTAINS 'ODAT' OR c.heading CONTAINS 'ODAT' RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 20
note: Literal (case-sensitive, since ODAT is an acronym) substring search for ODAT in chunk text/headings.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'condition' AND (toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'wait' OR toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'predecessor' OR toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'depend') RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Search chunks mentioning job conditions plus wait/predecessor/dependency terms, the typical Control-M job-dependency mechanism.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'file' AND (toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'trigger' OR toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'watch' OR toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'arrival') RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Search for file-arrival triggering concepts (file watcher/trigger/arrival) combined with 'file' to find job-triggering-by-file docs.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'holiday' RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Direct substring search for 'holiday' to surface calendar/holiday-exclusion scheduling chunks.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'pool' AND toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'variable' RETURN DISTINCT d.doc_id, d.title, d.purpose, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Find chunks mentioning both 'pool' and 'variable' to surface docs covering pool variables and their relation to %% user variables.

cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WITH collect(DISTINCT d.target_version) AS versions, collect(DISTINCT d.subject_product_id) AS products MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d2:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'automation api' AND (toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'compat' OR toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'version') RETURN versions, products, d2.doc_id, d2.title, d2.target_version, c.chunk_id, c.heading, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d2.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Collect distinct target_version/subject_product_id across all documents, then find chunks discussing Automation API compatibility.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE (toLower(d.title) CONTAINS 'api' OR toLower(d.path) CONTAINS 'api') AND toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'json' AND toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'job' RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, d.trust_default, d.classification, d.source, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.provenance, c.tier_rule, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Find JSON job-definition example chunks within API-titled/pathed documents and surface their provenance/tier_rule and document trust_default/classification/source to judge vendor-groundedness.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document) WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'autosys' AND toLower(c.text) CONTAINS 'global variable' RETURN d.doc_id, d.title, c.chunk_id, c.heading, c.seq, left(c.text, 600) AS excerpt ORDER BY d.doc_id, c.seq LIMIT 25
note: Search for AutoSys global variable chunks; if the corpus is Control-M-only this will likely return empty, which is itself informative.
